known_prior_result.finding: Industry 12-minus-6 beat SPY in validation and recent diagnostics but trailed it in development; breadth switching showed the opposite split.

purpose: Test a bounded growth-plus-defense family that makes QQQ exposure explicit, distinguishes beta/growth tilt from agentic selection, and targets raw SPY outperformance across both development and validation without leverage.
claim_boundary: Every historical interval is seen and the fixed ETF menu is selected with 2026 hindsight. Passing the raw-return track earns only a specialized retrospective shadow label; only the stricter balanced track may proceed toward overall champion status, and neither proves future profitability.

data.provider: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint adjusted close
data.null_policy: Use only common dates; never forward fill or splice series.
data.bias_boundary: The fixed menu contains only ETFs still available in 2026, so it has fund-survival and universe/menu-selection hindsight; dead or merged funds are absent. QQQ is also an obvious ex-post winner. The static 50/50 SPY/QQQ control is mandatory so growth exposure cannot be relabeled as algorithmic alpha.

execution.signal_trade_return: close-t information -> close-t+1 execution -> first t+1-to-t+2 return
execution.native_cadence_and_discovery_anchor: Each strategy uses its declared 5- or 21-session interval with rebalance anchor zero in discovery; all native anchors are mandatory after selection.
execution.levered_diagnostic_exception: Only the visible, ineligible 1.5x SPY baseline may use gross cap 1.5 and negative BIL financing. Every Generation 4 control and candidate is simulated with cap 1.
execution.standalone_boundaries: Every named slice and annual-origin window starts from BIL and charges final risky liquidation.

deterministic_rank_ties: Every ranked top/highest asset or sector selection uses alphabetical ticker order to break an exact numeric tie. Explicit binary gates use their stated strict inequality and fallback instead; in the QQQ-versus-SPY gate, equality falls back to SPY.

registered_formulas.formula: Every 21 sessions rebalance to 50% SPY and 50% QQQ. This explanatory growth-tilt control cannot become Finly.
Every five sessions compute mean 63/126/252 BIL-excess log momentum for QQQ and SPY. Hold QQQ only if its score is strictly higher and QQQ is strictly above inclusive SMA200; otherwise hold SPY.
Every 21 sessions hold 50% SPY, 25% QQQ, and divide 25% equally among the top three original-nine sectors by log(P[t-126]/P[t-252]).
Every 21 sessions hold 50% QQQ and divide 50% equally among the top three original-nine sectors by log(P[t-126]/P[t-252]).
Every 21 sessions hold QQQ if its 252-session BIL-excess log return is positive; otherwise hold the highest positive 252-session BIL-excess asset among IEF/TLT/GLD, or BIL if none is positive.
Every five sessions hold QQQ if above inclusive SMA200 with positive 63-session return; otherwise hold the highest positive mean 126/252 BIL-excess asset among IEF/TLT/GLD, or BIL.
Every 21 sessions hold the highest positive mean 63/126/252 BIL-excess asset among QQQ/SPY/IWM/IEF/TLT/GLD, or BIL if all scores are nonpositive.

Every five sessions hold 50% SPY/50% QQQ when QQQ is above inclusive SMA200 with positive 63-session return; otherwise retain 50% SPY and allocate the other half to the highest positive mean 126/252 BIL-excess IEF/TLT/GLD, or BIL.

required: net annualized log growth exceeds SPY in development and validation
validation annualized log-growth edge is at least 50 bp
median validation edge is positive in 252/504/756-session annual-origin families
at least 60% of every validation window family beats SPY
validation maximum drawdown is no worse than SPY by over two percentage points
validation volatility does not exceed QQQ
recent hard-safety veto does not fire

required_in_addition_to_raw: validation volatility does not exceed SPY
validation BIL-excess Sharpe exceeds frozen Finly and 15% SPY volatility targeting by at least 0.10
validation drawdown is within two points of frozen Finly and no worse than 15%

selection_tracks.objective: Within each track maximize the smaller development/validation annualized log-growth edge; tie-break by higher validation edge, then alphabetical ID. Recent data cannot rank or break ties.
selection_tracks.recent_hard_safety_veto: After selection, veto if 2025-2026 maximum drawdown is below -20%, total return trails BIL, or drawdown is over five points worse than SPY.

post_selection_robustness: raw edge keeps its sign at 5/10/25 bp costs
raw edge keeps its sign across every native rebalance anchor
Deflated-Sharpe probability is at least 0.95 using 100 trials
fixed-candidate familywise p-value is at most 0.05 for circular and moving 5/20/60-session blocks
the candidate beats or is explicitly distinguished from the static SPY/QQQ control
authenticated source-overlap checks pass for every used symbol
